violations.description: COOKING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (5 pts): Potentially hazardous food noted not being adequately reheated. Food items such as ground beef cheese sauce and chicken reheating in counter top steam table was not reheated rapidly enough. Observed ground beef at 95?F chicken at 110?F and cheese sauce at 103?F.
CONTAMINATION BY EMPLOYEES (3 pts): Observed ready to eat food items being handled with soiled gloves.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Clamshell's and single use cups noted being stored on the floor in the upstairs storage area.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Observed cupboard shelving edges and drawer front edges noted not in good repair. Exposed absorbent surfaces.
